== encoder-unknown
(no invocation)
error: unknown encoder "not_a_real_encoder" (known: [amf av1_nvenc cpu nvenc qsv svtav1 vaapi])
== encoder-empty
(no invocation)
error: unknown encoder "" (known: [amf av1_nvenc cpu nvenc qsv svtav1 vaapi])
